project.name: Thunder Vector 3D
project.goal: A compact vertical 3D shoot-'em-up inspired by classic Raiden-style arcade pacing.

workflow_rules: The user selects or approves a task.
Codex reads AGENTS.md and this graph before editing.
Codex may call the local Ollama reviewer through MCP for planning and review.
Every completed task must include evidence: changed files and a verification command.
The game must remain playable offline and must not call cloud APIs at runtime.

evidence.text: Per the user's explicit image/去背 direction, replaced the former GLB requirement with seven original ImageGen RGBA assets for player, scout, heavy, boss, and three pickups. Each accepted source is a 1254x1254 alpha-blended PNG with four transparent corners and 100% transparent sampled borders. visual_factory.gd mounts them as Sprite3D overlays on Node3D actors while preserving 3D camera/collisions and hidden procedural fallback meshes. .\scripts\verify.ps1 exited 0 including ART_INTEGRATION_TEST_PASS for all seven roles, alpha, fallback visibility, enemy orientation, and GL Compatibility. A real Windows/OpenGL 3.3 Compatibility capture on AMD Radeon RX 7600 produced docs/screenshots/gameplay_preview.png at 1280x720 with PREVIEW_CAPTURE_PASS; visual inspection found no black boxes, clipping, wrong orientation, or hull bleed-through. Prompts and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in game/assets/generated/ART_PROVENANCE.md.

Added offline ConfigFile persistence at user://settings.cfg for master/SFX volume, windowed/fullscreen mode, 1280x720/1600x900/1920x1080 resolution, and easy/normal/hard difficulty. O opens a keyboard-only settings overlay; Enter/Esc/O saves and returns to pause. Added a routed SFX bus and difficulty profiles that only scale enemy pressure. .\scripts\verify.ps1 exited 0 with static checks, 5 Python tests, Godot 4.7.2 import/parser, SETTINGS_STORE_TEST_PASS, SETTINGS_UI_TEST_PASS, and a 15-second main-scene smoke test. Changed game/scripts/main.gd, game/default_bus_layout.tres, scripts/verify.ps1, and tools/verify_project.py; added game/scripts/settings_store.gd plus two GDScript tests.

Installed the official Godot 4.7.2 standard export templates after verifying the 1,281,349,702-byte TPZ against SHA-256 f298490b8d44d934be425a5a65a51bf15f422428b229a06a6e11d9ffea248011 and the official SHA-512. The complete verification gate passed and Godot exported a fresh 121,051,880-byte Windows x86_64 PE. Launching that unsigned EXE was then blocked by this host's enforced Windows 11 Smart App Control policy (VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState=1; Code Integrity events 3077 and 3033) from both Codex PowerShell and signed Windows PowerShell. The node is not done: an actual exported-EXE launch on a non-enforcing clean Windows VM/device or trusted CA code signing remains required. Build scripts now prevent stale-output success, validate engine/template version, PE architecture, logs, launch behavior and ZIP integrity; an explicit -SkipLaunchValidation path records the skipped state without claiming launch success.

The existing build/ThunderVector3D.exe launched successfully through Windows Computer Use on this host and exposed one live window titled Thunder Vector 3D. A screenshot-backed state capture showed active gameplay at the level-3 boss encounter. This clears the prior host-local Smart App Control launch block; an independent clean-machine launch remains pending, so the node is not marked done.
